{{Top|leg}}
'''Kapchenaga''' was the [[Gwurran]] thunder god who boomed from the north, announcing his advance with steady earthward thrusts of the Light-That-Burned (lightning).<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
